column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Chapter 1 / Courreges

column2: Just because you're awake... doesn't mean you can move yet!
You've been asleep all this time— your body's in for a shock!
So you won't get bored, I'll tell you a story!
The day of that huge $$落雷$$... uh...
You don't remember it, do you!?
You went into the mountains alone to gather $$薬草$$ for me when I had a $$風邪$$...!
Why didn't I take you to a $$医者$$, you ask? W-Well...
There were... circumstances that meant I couldn't go...
Anyway, you went deep into the mountains, and it seems you got caught up in some kind of $$事故$$...!
I think it must have been a very serious $$事故$$.
(Because... 　I saw it...!)
(That day, after the rain stopped, 　when I was finally able to move again 　and went into the mountains...)
(The $$死体$$ of so many $$兵士達$$, 　lying in a circle around you...!!)
When I saw you, $$血だらけ$$, barely breathing...
I was so devastated... for a moment, I couldn't think of anything at all...
(If I were left alone in this $$世界$$, 　I...)
*sniff*...
But I'm glad I pulled myself together and kept trying all this time!
Because you...
opened your eyes for me again.
Now, get some rest! I don't think you should push yourself any more... today, at least!
Get well soon, okay?
